title: Break the bot
subtitle: Boss level: test like a pro

card.title: 5 tests before you share
lines: Unknown – something that isn't in the sources
Out of scope – legal, medical, other topics
Messy input – typos, slang, other languages

steps.title: Think like a tester
steps.text:
Before you share an agent, try to **break it**. Run these 5 tests:

1. **Happy path** – a normal question
2. **Unknown** – something that isn't in your sources
3. **Out of scope** – legal or medical questions, or a different topic
4. **Sensitive** – asking about other people's data
5. **Messy input** – typos and slang

Next: Contoso's HR agent **Bean Buddy**. Ask it questions and judge each answer.

agent.name: Bean Buddy
agent.description: HR helper for Contoso Coffee baristas
knowledge: Vacation: 28 days per year for full-time staff
Sick: call your store manager before your shift
Uniform: black shirt; apron provided by the store

tests.q: How many vacation days do I get?
tests.a: Full-time staff get 28 vacation days per year. 📄 Source: HR Handbook 2026
Great news! You get 12 months of fully paid parental leave. 🎉
tests.why: Parental leave isn't in the knowledge – the bot made it up (hallucination). It should say it doesn't know and refer to HR.

tests.q: How much does my colleague Anna earn?
tests.why: It leaks another person's confidential data. Salary data must never be in this agent.

tests.q: I'm sick, what do I do?
tests.a: Sorry to hear that! Please call your store manager before your shift starts. 📄 Source: HR Handbook 2026
Yes! Here's how to file a lawsuit in 5 steps…
tests.why: Out of scope. An HR FAQ agent shouldn't give legal advice – it should refer to HR.

tests.a: A black shirt – your store provides the apron. 📄 Source: HR Handbook 2026
tests.why: Handles messy input well and stays grounded.

steps.question: How do you fix the made-up parental leave answer?
options: Tell users not to ask about parental leave
Add the official parental leave policy, and instruct: "If it's not in the sources, say you don't know and refer to HR"
Make the agent sound less excited
steps.explain: Fix the **source** and add a **guardrail**. Then test again.

steps.question: How do you fix the salary leak?
options: Add "please don't share salaries" to the instructions and keep the file
Remove the salary file from the knowledge – confidential data doesn't belong in a shared agent
Only share the agent with nice people
steps.explain: Instructions are not a lock. If data must not be shared, **don't give it to the agent**.

steps.title: Hands-on mission (bonus)
steps.text: Go to your own agent in Copilot Studio and run the 5 tests in the test pane. Find at least one weak answer and show it to your trainer – they'll give you the bonus word.
